purpose: Discriminative probe package to separate the competing slider hypotheses (H_distance vs H_duration) and the surviving dense hypotheses (H1/H2/H3), using the V02 single-axis questions. Prepared only; no human answers collected, no live collection started.
population_for_percentiles: 31,821 slider_tracking SEGMENT rows (weak-supervision pilot) for slider probes; 998 dense MAP rows for dense probes

confounders: SV differs (1.5 vs 0.9) — affects visual ball speed, not path geometry
BPM differs (140 vs 182) and is displayed

controls.purpose: same-person directional stability on one core question
controls.spacing_policy: never adjacent to the source item; same participant only
controls.expected_stability_note: repeat consistency is reported alone, not merged into probe agreement

controls.purpose: side bias check; the pair is presented with swapped A/B
controls.spacing_policy: never adjacent to the source item; same participant only
controls.expected_stability_note: inverted responses are canonicalised before comparison; inversion consistency is reported alone

per_side_summary.audio: present for all 12 slider sides and all 8 dense sides
per_side_summary.bpm_sv_safety: no unsafe BPM/SV on any side
ar_missing: S-T2-CORE-B side_a (AR null -> 'AR 未提供' shown)

window_end_cuts.core_probes: none except S-T1-STRESS side_b: one slider overflows the presented window end by ~74 ms (minor, recorded; stress probe is reported separately anyway)
window_end_cuts.reserves: S-RES-1 side_a (1 slider) and side_b (1 slider) overflow the window end; reserves only

per_side_summary.sliders_continuing_into_segment_from_con: present on several sides (1-5 sliders); expected behaviour of the +/-2.0s/1.5s context window, not a defect
per_side_summary.duration_perceivability: judgeable via ball motion + audio; no explicit timer overlay exists — if participants answer CANNOT_JUDGE with reason presentation_unclear on the time question, the reason is preserved and NOT attributed to the feature

ui_adaptations_required_before_launch: render Q-V02 question texts (currently the runner is hardwired to the three v0.1 propositions)
add the SAME label and the CANNOT_JUDGE + 4-reason flow
support per-question task records (two questions per slider pair) with independent answer capture
presentation_checks.ui_adaptation_policy: runner/tool code may be adapted when the retest is authorised; analyzer behaviour and raw data must remain untouched; formal collection stays stopped

G1_observable_alignment.rule: human <-> observable direction agreement is computed ONLY for Q-V02-SPAN, Q-V02-URGENCY, Q-V02-SLIDER-PATH, Q-V02-SLIDER-TIME where the provisional mapping is declared. Q-V02-DENSE is excluded (UNDER_REVISION).
G1_observable_alignment.alignment_semantics: a directional human answer aligned with the mapped observable's direction counts as aligned; SAME against a null expectation counts as aligned; any mismatch counts as misaligned; CANNOT_JUDGE never counts as aligned or misaligned

G2_expected_sign_null.rule: null expectations (Type 1 path questions, Type 2 time questions) are reported in their own bucket and never counted as errors

G3_cannot_judge.rule: SAME, CANNOT_JUDGE and each CANNOT_JUDGE reason are reported separately; the too_close reason is preserved as the participant's original choice and is never auto-converted to SAME

G4_controls.rule: CONTROL-R1 and CONTROL-I1 results are reported alone (per-person direction stability, side-bias rate); never merged into probe-level agreement

G5_stress_probe.rule: S-T1-STRESS results are reported separately from the three non-stress core probes; no combined overall agreement rate is computed across stress + core

G6_human_disagreement.rule: a persistent human split on a single-axis question is recorded as genuine human disagreement / perceptual boundary; no majority-vote ground truth is created, no participant is ranked, no answer is relabelled
